content: क्लिशित, -क्लिष्ट {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Distressed, suffering pain or misery. .²2 Afflicted, tormented. .²3 Faded. .²4 Inconsistent, contradictory; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} माता मे वन्ध्या. .²5 Elaborate, artificial (as a composition.). .²6 Put to shame. .²7 Wearied; hurt, injured. .²8 Being in a bad condition, worn; पीतेनैकेन संवीतां क्लिष्टतोत्तमवाससा <ls>Rām. 5. 15. 21</ls>. .²9 Marred, impaired; <ls>Ś. 5. 19</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 11</ls>; <ls>Ś. 6. 10</ls>; disordered, <ls>Ś. 7. 14</ls>. .²10 Dimmed, made faint; हिमक्लिष्टप्रकाशानि ज्योतींषीव मुखानि वः <ls>Ku. 2. 19</ls>. .²11 Injured, hurt; <ls>Ś. 6. 19</ls>. .²12 Bothersome, tedious; यथा शरीरो बालस्य गुप्तः सन्क्लिष्टकर्मणः <ls>Rām. 7. 75. 4</ls>. (the commentator Rāma Tilaka gives क्लिष्टकर्मणः = शुभाचारस्य, which seems doubtful). .{@-ष्टम्@} A contradictory statement.
